<a id="L212460"></a>**L212460**　warm winter clothing, blankets, and funds are required. The wounded

<a id="L212461"></a>**L212461**　must be taken care of in the rear of the enemy. Supplies must 

<a id="L212462"></a>**L212462**　be sent to them constantly and this takes funds and supplies in 

<a id="L212463"></a>**L212463**　large quantities. Just to transport one wounded soldier from the 

<a id="L212464"></a>**L212464**　Shansi front to a base hospital it takes $800.00. Many operations 

<a id="L212465"></a>**L212465**　have to be done without anesthesia. No pain-killing drugs are to 

<a id="L212466"></a>**L212466**　be had. 

<a id="L212467"></a>**L212467**　Bandages, gauze and antiseptics are not to be had in 

<a id="L212468"></a>**L212468**　sufficient quantities. The refugees are constantly coming in an and 

<a id="L212469"></a>**L212469**　are mostly women and children. 

<a id="L212470"></a>**L212470**　Their menfolk have joined the 

<a id="L212471"></a>**L212471**　partisans and their families must be taken 

<a id="L212472"></a>**L212472**　care of. 

<a id="L212473"></a>**L212473**　Funds for 

<a id="L212474"></a>**L212474**　their relief are urgently needed. A  million and one needs can be 

<a id="L212475"></a>**L212475**　listed so that any help will go a very long way.

<a id="L212476"></a>**L212476**　W e  appeal to your organization to help in collecting medical 

<a id="L212477"></a>**L212477**　and surgical supplies to care for the wounded and the refugees. Any 

<a id="L212478"></a>**L212478**　contributions 

<a id="L212479"></a>**L212479**　and supplies can reach us thru the China Defense 

<a id="L212480"></a>**L212480**　League, Hongkong, China, or thru your national organization if 

<a id="L212481"></a>**L212481**　especially marked for the 8th Route Army Trustee Committee.

<a id="L212482"></a>**L212482**　With greeting,

<a id="L212483"></a>**L212483**　M A O  T S E - T U N G ,  Hon. Chairman 

<a id="L212484"></a>**L212484**　LI F U - C H U N ,  Chairman

<a id="L212485"></a>**L212485**　三

<a id="L212486"></a>**L212486**　五

<a id="L212491"></a>**L212491**　To American Friends of the Chinese People

<a id="L212492"></a>**L212492**　1938

<a id="L212493"></a>**L212493**　American Friends of the Chinese People 

<a id="L212494"></a>**L212494**　168 West 23rd Street,

<a id="L212495"></a>**L212495**　N e w  York City, N. Y.，U.S.A.

<a id="L212496"></a>**L212496**　Dear Friends,

<a id="L212497"></a>**L212497**　W e  are enclosing a circular announcement of the 8th Route 

<a id="L212498"></a>**L212498**　Army Trustee Committee and wish to appeal for your special support 

<a id="L212499"></a>**L212499**　for a very urgent cause.

<a id="L212500"></a>**L212500**　Of course we know that you have carried on numerous activi­

<a id="L212501"></a>**L212501**　ties in supporting the cause of world peace and obtaining aid for China. 

<a id="L212502"></a>**L212502**　This time in addition we appeal to you to divert part of your sup­

<a id="L212503"></a>**L212503**　port for a region where untold suffering and need exist. This region

<a id="L212504"></a>**L212504**　---North and Northwest China---  is becoming more and more the

<a id="L212505"></a>**L212505**　base for large scale partisan and guerilla warfare against Japan, 

<a id="L212506"></a>**L212506**　especially in the rear of the enemy. The 8th Route Army and the 

<a id="L212507"></a>**L212507**　partisan-peasant detachments here have been fighting hand in hand 

<a id="L212508"></a>**L212508**　in this region for more than a year and are in urgent need of help.

<a id="L212509"></a>**L212509**　三

<a id="L212510"></a>**L212510**　五

<a id="L212511"></a>**L212511**　八
